description: Source code for MCP (Model Context Protocol) client in Pipecat, enabling integration of external tools with LLMs via various server connection types (stdio, SSE, HTTP). Contains class MCPClient with methods for tool registration, schema conversion, and communication handling.

classes.name: MCPClient
classes.description: Client for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, supporting stdio, SSE, and HTTP connections, with methods for tool registration, schema conversion, and communication.

methods.name: register_tools
methods.description: Registers all available MCP tools with an LLM service by discovering, converting schemas, and registering functions.

methods.name: get_tools_schema
methods.description: Retrieves the schema of all available MCP tools without registering them.

methods.name: register_tools_schema
methods.description: Registers a given ToolsSchema with an LLM service.

methods.name: _convert_mcp_schema_to_pipecat
methods.description: Converts an MCP tool schema to Pipecat's FunctionSchema format.

methods.name: _sse_list_tools
methods.description: Lists available MCP tools over SSE connection.

methods.name: _sse_tool_wrapper
methods.description: Wraps MCP tool calls for SSE connection to match Pipecat's interface.

methods.name: _stdio_list_tools
methods.description: Lists available MCP tools over stdio connection.

methods.name: _stdio_tool_wrapper
methods.description: Wraps MCP tool calls for stdio connection to match Pipecat's interface.

methods.name: _streamable_http_list_tools
methods.description: Lists MCP tools over streamable HTTP connection.

methods.name: _streamable_http_tool_wrapper
methods.description: Wraps MCP tool calls for streamable HTTP connection.

methods.name: _call_tool
methods.description: Executes a call to an MCP tool, processes results, applies output filters, and invokes callback.

methods.name: _list_tools_helper
methods.description: Helper to list and process available tools from a session, converting schemas.
